fixtures.description: Ground friction step-trace: player on flat map with initial vx=1.0, zero input, 10 ticks; velocity.x decays by f=dt*4+1 per tick.
Air friction: player airborne at z=32 with vx=1.0, zero input, 5 ticks; velocity.x decays by f=dt+1 per tick.
Wade friction: player at z=62.5 with vx=1.0, zero input, 10 ticks; position.z>61 triggers wade=true and f=dt*6+1 per tick.
Jump vz=-0.36: player on flat ground, jump=true tick 0, 3 ticks; tick-0 velocity.z=-0.36 characterizes PlayerJump constant.
Jump cooldown listener gate: jump tick 0, release tick 1, re-jump tick 2; velocity.z=-0.36 at both jumps; characterizes that cooldown only gates PlayerJumped listener, not vz assignment.
Crouch offset 0.9: player standing, crouch=true tick 0; position.z increases by 0.9 on crouch-down transition.
Step-climb: 1-block wall at (258,256,61), player at (256,256,60.5) moving +x; climb fires, velocity.x/y halved, player rises.
Step-climb suppression: same wall, crouch=true; climb is suppressed, velocity.x zeroed by wall collision.

BoxClipMove wall collision: player at (256,256,60.5) moving +x into 2-block-tall solid wall at (258,256,60-61); velocity.x zeroed at collision tick (BoxClipMove:1052/1055). Single-block wall would allow step-climb; 2-block wall isolates pure wall-collision path.
BoxClipMove floor collision: player airborne at z=57 with zero velocity falls under gravity to flat-map ground; airborne→false, velocity.z→0 at landing tick (BoxClipMove:1104-1109).
BoxClipMove ceiling collision: player at z=55 moving up (vel.z=-0.5) hits ceiling block at (256,256,53); velocity.z zeroed at collision tick (BoxClipMove:1109 else branch).

TryUncrouch blocked: crouched player at z≈61.4 with solid block at z=60 (head-raise path blocked by position.z-1.35=60.05); crouch-off transition rejected by TryUncrouch; local player reverts to crouch=true (Player.cpp:113-114); position.z unchanged.

MoveCorpse path: alive=false player at z=61 with vel=(0.2,0,1.0); gravity accumulation (vz+=0.5*dt/tick); bounce at tick 1 when position crosses z=62 floor (velocity*=0.36 factor, position reverted to oldPos).
Packet-roundtrip exemplar: empty WorldUpdate (player_count 0) hex-encoded.
Value-lookup exemplar: IsSolid query at (0,0,62) on flat map returns solid.
0.75 golden sequence: StateData(CTF) -> ExistingPlayer x2 -> WorldUpdate v3 (implicit index) -> frozen WorldSnapshot.
0.76 golden sequence: StateData(CTF) -> ExistingPlayer x2 -> WorldUpdate v4 (sparse explicit index) -> frozen WorldSnapshot.
WorldUpdate v0.75 short-branch (24B/entry, implicit index): CreatePlayer x2 -> WorldUpdate v3 repositions both.
WorldUpdate v0.76 full-branch (25B/entry, explicit per-entry index): CreatePlayer x2 (sparse ids) -> WorldUpdate v4 repositions both.
MapStart packet-roundtrip: single uint32 mapSize, version-independent wire layout (v3/v4 difference is a NetClient send side-effect).

ExtensionInfo negotiation (value_lookup): synthetic ExtensionInfo packet advertises {id 0 v1, id 192 v1}; the fold records all advertised extensions per A3 (wire fact, not NetClient's implementedExtensions filter). expected.value is the populated extensions map id->version.

Documented truncated StateData (tag+playerId only); rejection asserted by ProtocolMalformedTest (the fixture is corpus documentation of the malformed input — the runtime SPRaise is the C++ EXPECT_THROW test, PROT-06).

PHYS-03 multi-step determinism golden: 60-tick scripted input sequence (move/jump/crouch/strafe varied per schedule) starting from (256,256,60.5); full per-tick position/velocity/orientation/airborne/wade; re-run 20x in CI produces identical output.
